title: [Good first issue] [CPU PLUGIN] fix testcase issue in function tests on SPR platform
body:
## Description:
Some test cases failed on SPR platform, need to debug and fix it. 

## How to reproduce:
1. comment this code https://github.com/openvinotoolkit/openvino/blob/fa43c7b364b6899a90da2b3a27d77461235a5071/src/plugins/intel_cpu/tests/functional/shared_tests_instances/skip_tests_config.cpp#L374 like this
`// retVector.emplace_back(R"(smoke_Reduce.*/ReduceCPULayerTest.*axes=\((0.1|1)\).*Prod_KeepDims.*INFERENCE_PRECISION_HINT=f16.*)");`
2. Build the OV using `-DENABLE_TESTS=ON -DENABLE_FUNACTIONAL_TESTS=ON -DENABLE_INTEL_CPU=ON`
3. Build `./ov_cpu_func_tests` target
```
./ov_cpu_func_tests --gtest_filter="smoke_Reduce_OneAxis_CPU/ReduceCPULayerTest.CompareWithRefs*" > /home/<user>/log_f09d2e26.txt
[ RUN      ] smoke_Reduce_OneAxis_CPU/ReduceCPULayerTest.CompareWithRefs/IS=([]_)_TS=((2.19.2.9)_)_axes=(1)_opType=SCALAR_type=Prod_KeepDims=true_netPRC=f32_inPRC=undefined_outPRC=undefined_PluginConf_INFERENCE_PRECISION_HINT=f16

MEM_USAGE=53223240KB
[ COMPARATION ] rel_threshold: 1.79769e+308
[ COMPARATION ] abs_threshold: 0.00596758
src/tests/functional/shared_test_classes/src/base/ov_subgraph.cpp:99: Failure
abs_max < abs_threshold && rel_max < rel_threshold
         abs_max: 0.00645041
                 coordinate 16; abs errors count 1; abs mean 0.000524167; abs threshold 0.00596758
         rel_max: 0.00385685
                 coordinate 31; rel errors count 0; rel mean 0.00124679; rel threshold 1.79769e+308
[  FAILED  ] smoke_Reduce_OneAxis_CPU/ReduceCPULayerTest.CompareWithRefs/IS=([]_)_TS=((2.19.2.9)_)_axes=(1)_opType=SCALAR_type=Prod_KeepDims=true_netPRC=f32_inPRC=undefined_outPRC=undefined_PluginConf_INFERENCE_PRECISION_HINT=f16, where GetParam() = (({ 1 }, SCALAR, true, Prod, 4-byte object <05-00 00-00>, 4-byte object <00-00 00-00>, 4-byte object <00-00 00-00>, { ({}, { { 2, 19, 2, 9 } }) }), ({}, {}, {}, ""), (16-byte object <00-00 00-00 00-00 00-00 00-00 00-00 00-00 00-00>, {}), { ("INFERENCE_PRECISION_HINT", f16) }) (7 ms)
```
4. if there is no SPR machine, download SDE from https://<redacted-host>/content/www/us/en/developer/articles/tool/software-development-emulator.html
    run command 
`/home/<user>/sde-external-9.27.0-2023-09-13-lin/sde64 -spr -- ./ov_cpu_func_tests --gtest_filter="smoke_Reduce_OneAxis_CPU/ReduceCPULayerTest.CompareWithRefs*"`

## How to fix
Currently I found the test case start to failed from commit https://github.com/openvinotoolkit/openvino/commit/f09d2e26668021d5b3f6bc5fffd6d715124add9b
need to debug it
1. maybe need to check the difference of execute graph https://github.com/openvinotoolkit/openvino/blob/master/src/plugins/intel_cpu/docs/debug_capabilities/graph_serialization.md
2. maybe need to need to check the difference of dump blob https://github.com/openvinotoolkit/openvino/blob/master/src/plugins/intel_cpu/docs/debug_capabilities/blob_dumping.md
3. maybe also need to check the log https://github.com/openvinotoolkit/openvino/blob/master/src/plugins/intel_cpu/docs/debug_capabilities/logging.md
4. maybe also need to check the verbose https://github.com/openvinotoolkit/openvino/blob/master/src/plugins/intel_cpu/docs/debug_capabilities/verbose.md
